Description: An introductory course covering the basic principles of electrical installation, including safety practices, tools, and fundamental circuit theory applicable in residential and industrial settings.
LearningOutcomes: Demonstrate safe use of electrical tools and equipment in accordance with Zambia electrical standards.
Identify and explain the components of a basic electrical circuit.
Apply fundamental wiring techniques to complete simple installation tasks.

Description: This course introduces students to national and international wiring regulations and standards, focusing on compliance, inspection, and testing of electrical installations.
LearningOutcomes: Interpret and apply relevant Zambian and IEE wiring regulations in electrical installations.
Conduct inspection and testing procedures on completed electrical installations.
Prepare accurate documentation and compliance records for electrical work.

Description: An introductory course providing students with foundational knowledge and practical skills in welding, including arc welding, safety protocols, and basic metallurgy.
LearningOutcomes: Apply appropriate personal protective equipment and safety procedures in a welding environment.
Perform basic shielded metal arc welding (SMAW) joints to acceptable quality standards.
Identify common welding defects and describe methods for their prevention and correction.

Description: Building on foundational welding skills, this course covers advanced welding processes including MIG, TIG, and gas welding, as well as metal fabrication and structural welding applications.
LearningOutcomes: Execute MIG and TIG welding techniques to industry-acceptable quality standards.
Fabricate structural components using appropriate welding processes and materials.
Interpret engineering drawings and welding symbols to produce accurate fabricated assemblies.

Description: This course develops students' written and oral communication skills in a business context, covering professional writing, presentations, and interpersonal communication for the workplace.
LearningOutcomes: Compose clear and professional business letters, emails, and reports.
Deliver effective oral presentations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrate appropriate interpersonal communication skills in professional workplace settings.

Description: This elective course equips technical students with entrepreneurial skills to start and manage small businesses in their trade, covering business planning, financial literacy, and market analysis.
LearningOutcomes: Develop a comprehensive business plan for a small technical enterprise.
Apply basic financial management principles including budgeting, costing, and pricing.
Identify market opportunities and design strategies for business growth in the Zambian context.

Description: An introductory course covering fundamental computer literacy and the use of office productivity applications, internet tools, and basic data management relevant to technical and business environments.
LearningOutcomes: Use word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software to produce professional documents.
Navigate the internet and digital communication tools safely and effectively.
Organise and manage digital files and data using standard operating system tools.

Description: This course introduces students to computer hardware troubleshooting, operating system support, and fundamental networking concepts including LAN setup, IP addressing, and network troubleshooting.
LearningOutcomes: Diagnose and resolve common hardware and software faults in desktop computer systems.
Configure and manage a basic local area network (LAN) using switches and routers.
Apply structured troubleshooting methodologies to resolve network connectivity issues.
